name: MoodMate Built-in Companion (Instant)
description: Empathetic companion with music psychology & iso-principle. Zero setup or keys required.
privacy_notice: Runs 100% locally on your computer with zero external network calls.
free_tier_note: 100% free and always ready. No terminal commands or API keys.

name: Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (Free Tier)
description: High intelligence, fast responses, and excellent multilingual fluency (English/Hindi/Bengali).
privacy_notice: Messages are sent to Google Gemini to generate replies.
free_tier_note: Free tier with rate limits (15 RPM / 1M TPM). Free key from Google AI Studio.

name: Groq Llama 3.3 70B (Free Tier)
description: Ultra-low latency cloud inference on state-of-the-art open weights.
privacy_notice: Messages are sent to Groq's high-speed cloud to generate replies.
free_tier_note: Free tier with rate limits (30 RPM). Free key from console.groq.com.

name: Ollama Llama 3.2 (Local)
description: Private, runs on your machine. Fast, lightweight & private.
privacy_notice: Local model: messages never leave your computer.
free_tier_note: 100% free. Requires Ollama installed on your machine ('ollama run llama3.2').

name: Ollama Qwen 2.5 (Local)
description: Private local model with strong multilingual capabilities (Hindi/Bengali).
privacy_notice: Local model: messages never leave your computer.
free_tier_note: 100% free. Requires Ollama installed on your machine ('ollama run qwen2.5').

name: OpenRouter Free Llama 3.3
description: Access to community-hosted free open models via OpenRouter.
privacy_notice: Messages are sent to OpenRouter free community endpoints.
free_tier_note: Free tier models change availability. Free key from openrouter.ai.
